basis: Manually maintained ecosystem classifications from public KuCoin educational material; not the exchange Solana-tab universe.
historical_basis: Retrospective operational classification; not point-in-time historical exchange membership evidence.
contract_identifier_policy: Apply these classifications only if the independent contract universe supplies the exact identifier. This file does not assert present or historical tradability.

SOLUSDTM.basis: SOL is the native asset of Solana.

RAYUSDTM.basis: Raydium and its RAY token belong to the Solana DEX ecosystem.

JUPUSDTM.basis: Jupiter and its JUP token are part of the Solana DEX ecosystem.

JTOUSDTM.basis: Jito and the JTO governance token are part of Solana staking infrastructure.

ORCAUSDTM.basis: Orca and its ORCA token belong to the Solana DEX ecosystem.

XBTUSDTM.basis: Operational classification of the native Bitcoin asset, not wrapped Bitcoin tokens on other networks.

ETHUSDTM.basis: Operational classification of native Ether on Ethereum, not wrapped Ether tokens on other networks.
